I'll check what you've been training and what your numbers look like. You haven't logged any training yet, so I can't see what you've been doing. That means the first step is to get started: pick a program or build workouts that put back work in front. Back is a big muscle group—rows, pull-ups, lat pulldowns, face pulls—and it responds well to 8–15 reps per set, 3–4 sets per exercise, trained twice a week.

Once you log some sessions, I can track your progress and dial in what works best for you. Ready to start?
